prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web interface concept, 1440 × 900 landscape
Primary request: Redesign the ‘Memories’ page for the personal archive ‘nono & txx’. This is an Experience surface for two people who browse and maintain a long-term shared archive. The concept is ‘Shared Chronicle’: a refined editorial chronology where recent memory text and a continuous photo stream interlock in one reading rhythm, rather than separating gallery and timeline into unrelated sections.
Real content: ‘nono & txx’, ‘Memories’, ‘since 2025.09.17’, ‘最近的一天’, ‘2026.04.19’, ‘把今天也收藏起来’, ‘管理照片’, ‘暂停’, ‘全部年份’, ‘添加事件’, ‘立即备份’.
Reading order: compact utility header; a restrained introduction with archive count and current year; one dominant editorial chronology column with a real event excerpt and date; a continuous photographic ribbon cutting through and around that chronology without becoming a card grid; three event markers visible as the next section begins. Management controls are quiet and secondary.
Frame: complete edge-to-edge website screen with navigation, controls, first viewport, and a clear continuation below. No browser chrome, device, desk, paper mockup, or poster framing.
Reference image contribution: retain the existing warm neutral palette, serif/sans contrast, thin dividers, quiet spacing, and restrained controls. Do not copy the old huge title, repetitive equal cards, yellow star placeholder, or exact sections.
Visual law: cream archival paper ground, charcoal ink, muted wine accent for current selection; typographic dates feel precise and factual; photographs sit like lightly pressed archival prints with almost no shadow; one dominant diagonal or crossing photo ribbon creates movement, while text regions stay still and readable. No gradients, glassmorphism, decorative collage, or heavy borders.
Constraints: a real working website, not a printed poster; visible pause control; readable Chinese; photos remain dominant; complete-image viewer implied; no black surrounds; no decorative symbols; no fake commercial claims; no watermark.
